text:
maria: quick heads-up — VoltEdge shipped their initial kernel patch for the A7 board. thinking this is a good chance for a small joint perf run (perf/W + 99th-latency) before the marketplace listing. who can lead the runbook?

akash: I can take lead on the run orchestration. confirm scope: 4 models (gpt-small/med/large + embedder) at batch sizes 8/16/32 and short/long seq profiles?

lin: +1 on scope. also add a steady-state 1h soak at target qps to catch thermal throttles.

sofia (VoltEdge): happy to provide patched kernel + telemetry hooks. we'll expose power rails and board temps via i2c sensors and publish a helper mapping script.

maria: deliverables: run plan doc, reproducible infra scripts, golden charts (perf/W + p99), and a short joint blurb for marketing. timelines?

akash: timeline proposal — day 0 infra prep + kernel deploy; day 1 dry-run (smoke); day 2 full sweep (throughput & perf/W); day 3 analysis + charts. 4 working days total.

lin: metric note — ensure identical tokenization and prompt lengths across runs. checksum model binaries and use promptset v0.3. abort if checksums mismatch.

sofia (VoltEdge): will sync firmware and prometheus exporters by EOD. sensor map: VE_A7_PWR0 -> i2c:1:0x40, VE_A7_TEMP0 -> i2c:1:0x41

maria: for kernel tuning try two knob sets: default and "latency-optimized" (preemptive IRQ tweaks + packed TLS). surface perf/W regressions if any.

akash: knobs encoded as per-node JSON config (profile, irq_balance, cpu_gov, scheduler_tune).

lin: instrument KV cache hit rates and per-token emit timing. benchbot, include kv_cache_hit_pct and emit_time_per_token_ms in export.

benchbot: added metrics to template: [power_watts, total_tokens, p99_latency_ms, kv_cache_hit_pct, emit_time_per_token_ms, board_temp_c]. export prefix: voltedge_a7_run_<ts>.csv

maria: Sofia — can you publish raw traces to shared S3 with ACLs? aggregated charts only for public.

sofia (VoltEdge): yes — pushing to s3://ve-partner-shared/redwood-inference/voltedge-a7/1718888888/ with read ACL for both orgs. will coordinate creds offline.

akash: infra blocker — need a dedicated bench node group (2x A7) + control host. @lin can you provision k3s node group and nomad job?

lin: will create nodegroup and nomad job spec. ping for docker image tag.

maria: scheduling — 15m sync tomorrow 10:30 PT to go through checklist and sign-offs. invite incoming.

sofia (VoltEdge): 10:30 PT works. excited for the perf/W story. :rocket:

akash: action items:
- akash: create runbook + nomad job templates (due +1d)
- lin: provisioning + checksum test (due +1d)
- sofia: push kernel + sensor mapping + s3 creds (due today)
- maria: draft co-announcement blurb and PR template (due +3d)

maria: call out infra noise (thermal/psu) immediately in thread.

sofia (VoltEdge): will include PSU serials in metadata for traceability. :white_check_mark:

akash: posting runbook draft in this thread when ready.

lin: nomad job posted: https://internal.redwood/workspaces/benching/nomad/jobs/voltedge-a7-run — please review.

maria: thanks — closing until 10:30 sync.
